name: Exterior, slow approach
summary: A slow forward glide towards the building, with clouds drifting.
outcome: A slow forward glide towards the building in your photo, with clouds drifting and natural daylight.
photoGuidance: A photo of the front of the property in daylight.
Straight lines: hold the camera level.
The whole building in frame, with some sky above it.
limitations: The video stays within what your photo shows. It can't show rooms, angles or parts of the property that aren't in the photo.
Text and logos in your photo may change in the video. Check the result before you post it.

inputs.label: The property
inputs.help: For example, 'two-storey villa with a garden'.

options.label: As in the photo
options.prompt: The sky stays as in the photo, with slight natural movement.

options.label: Drifting clouds
options.prompt: Soft white clouds drift slowly across a clear sky.

inputs.label: Details to keep as they are
inputs.help: Optional. For example, the colour of your cups or the shape of a sign.

inputs.label: Anything to leave out
inputs.help: Optional. For example, no smoke or no people.

prompt.preserve: Keep everything in the photo recognisable: the same objects, shapes, colours and proportions. Keep any printed text, labels and logos as they are.
prompt.avoid: Do not add people, hands, text, captions, logos or new objects. No sudden cuts, no camera shake, no warping or melting of surfaces.
prompt.subject: The photo shows the exterior of {subject}.
prompt.composition: Keep the building whole and level in the frame.
prompt.environment: The surroundings stay exactly as in the photo.
prompt.camera: The camera glides slowly and smoothly forward towards the building.
prompt.lighting: Natural daylight, as in the photo.
prompt.preserveExtra: Keep the building's windows, doors and roofline exactly as they are.
